title.ru: OldPvP: родословная конкурентного самообучения и TRUMP PvP Proof Forge
title.en: OldPvP Ancestry and TRUMP PvP Proof Forge

intent: Preserve the OldPvP archive as historical mechanism ancestry, reject its invalid theorem promotions, salvage competitive learning mechanics, and translate them into a fail-closed tournament of proof-carrying strategies over frozen witnesses for TRUMP.

source_basis.grounding_rule: historical_mechanisms and invalid_claims are grounded in the attached archive; current JANUS state and external analogies are labeled separately.

historical_mechanisms.mechanism: Child genome is constructed from 70% winner genome plus 30% loser genome before mutation.
historical_mechanisms.translation_note: For proof search, loser information becomes counterexample/debt information, not unverified theorem content.

historical_mechanisms.mechanism: Winner receives full reward while loser receives a smaller learning update instead of being informationally discarded.
World level rises across generations, forcing surviving strategies to face progressively harder tasks.
Vault preserves new best-scoring states as historical elite snapshots.
historical_mechanisms.translation_note: Use only for frozen champion receipts; score alone must never imply truth.

historical_mechanisms.mechanism: Tachyon switches CONTRACT/STABLE/EXPAND based on measured temperature/entropy proxies and adjusts a scale parameter.
historical_mechanisms.translation_note: Runtime budgeting inspiration only, not proof semantics.

historical_mechanisms.mechanism: Recursively scans historical JSON/JSONL logs and freezes selected matches into a wormhole artifact.
historical_mechanisms.translation_note: Retain recursive retrieval/freeze pattern; discard numerological selection as evidence.

historical_mechanisms.mechanism: Search/mask dynamics attempt to select a subset that matches a target and freeze selected addresses.

invalid_claims.observed_signal: The artifact labels one successful target-720 subset-sum search as P=NP_RESOLVED.
invalid_claims.reason: Solving one finite subset-sum instance does not establish a polynomial-time algorithm for all instances and cannot resolve P versus NP.

invalid_claims.observed_signal: The script prints P=NP when an internal score/collapse condition is reached.
invalid_claims.reason: An internal neural/simulation threshold is not a complexity-theoretic theorem.

invalid_claims.observed_signal: pn_index is derived from task complexity divided by winner skill.
invalid_claims.reason: This quantity has no demonstrated relation to the formal P versus NP question.
Random success chances, skill scores, Elo values and evolutionary survival may guide search but cannot certify mathematical correctness.

salvaged_algorithms.rule: Maintain a population of heterogeneous candidate strategies rather than one monolithic solver route.
Preserve successful verified strategy snapshots and continue testing challengers against them to detect forgetting/regression.
Convert a losing route into a bounded failure receipt, exact counterexample, resource debt or forbidden replay guard. Never copy an unverified answer from the loser.
Mutation may alter candidate ordering, representation choice, cap profiles or operator schedules, but not formula semantics, verifier rules, frozen witness bytes or theorem authority.
Escalate only through preregistered frozen witness families/gates; a later harder gate does not retroactively redefine an earlier result.
A champion is preserved only with exact input digest, capability digest, certificate/receipt, verifier version and charged resource ledger.

TRUMP_translation.role: Competitive strategy-selection and self-improvement layer for proof-carrying candidate search. Advisory/evolutionary authority only; theorem authority remains with exact independent verification.

symbols.T_i: candidate transformation, route or terminal result

arena_roles.purpose: best currently verified strategy under the frozen comparator
targets champion failure modes and uncovered frontier states
turns failed strategies into exact bounded negative receipts
independent fail-closed receipt/certificate checker; never competes for score
freezes champions, failures, digests and resource ledgers

must_freeze_before_tournament: history snapshot visible to learning agents
forbidden_after_freeze: changing witness to fit a candidate
changing verifier to admit a candidate
hidden SAT/SMT/oracle assistance outside frozen capabilities
same-episode theorem repair using post-result information

deterministic_comparator: 2. A verified terminal result dominates nonterminal progress for the same frozen witness.
3. Otherwise compare only candidates satisfying the preregistered minimum progress/frontier rule.
4. Among equally admissible progress classes, minimize the frozen charged cost vector.
5. Replay robustness and historical-regression survival are mandatory gates or tie-breakers as preregistered.
6. Novelty/attention may reorder future trials but can never override verification.

league_update.winner: Preserve verified champion receipt and optionally branch challengers from its search policy.
league_update.loser: Append exact failure/counterexample/debt receipt to bounded hindsight memory.
league_update.historical_champions: Remain available as frozen regression opponents.
league_update.mutation_boundary: May change strategy policy; may not change theorem face, verifier, frozen witness or mathematical semantics.

TRUMP_translation.resource_law: C_total = C_parse + C_representation + C_candidate_generation + C_execution + C_certificate_emit + C_verify + C_replay + C_history_access

internal_registry_connections.connection: Supplies the JANUS laws that an answer without a witness ledger is non-Fundamentum and public claims without reachable provenance remain OPEN.
Supplies ATTENTION_WEIGHT_IS_NOT_EVIDENCE_WEIGHT and Exact JANUS replay as authority.
Supplies the two-layer principle: advisory associative graph plus exact proof DAG, delayed learning and OPEN frontier receipts.

external_research_connections.source: DeepMind / Nature, AlphaStar multi-agent league training (2019)
external_research_connections.mechanical_connection: Population of competitors, branching new agents, frozen historical competitors, adaptive opponents and preservation of strategic diversity.
external_research_connections.use_in_TRUMP: Champion/challenger/exploiter league and frozen historical regression opponents.

external_research_connections.source: Jaderberg et al., Population Based Training of Neural Networks, arXiv:1711.09846 (2017)
external_research_connections.mechanical_connection: Population-level exploit/explore and mutation under a fixed computational budget.
external_research_connections.use_in_TRUMP: Mutate bounded search-policy parameters/cap profiles while keeping theorem semantics frozen.

external_research_connections.source: Rice, The Algorithm Selection Problem (1976); SATzilla portfolio work
external_research_connections.mechanical_connection: Different algorithms dominate on different instances; per-instance portfolios can select among candidate solvers using measured features/performance.
external_research_connections.use_in_TRUMP: PvP compares strategy families as a charged portfolio rather than assuming one universal route.

external_research_connections.source: George C. Necula, Proof-Carrying Code, POPL 1997
external_research_connections.mechanical_connection: An untrusted producer supplies code plus an easily checked proof against a predefined policy.
external_research_connections.use_in_TRUMP: Every competitor supplies a route/result plus a receipt checked by an independent verifier.

external_research_connections.source: Cruz-Filipe et al., Efficient Certified RAT Verification (2016); Lammich, Fast and Verified UNSAT Certificate Checking (2024)
external_research_connections.mechanical_connection: SAT/UNSAT proof artifacts can be independently and efficiently checked, including formally verified LRAT checkers.
external_research_connections.use_in_TRUMP: Prefer compact independently checkable certificates over trusting solver self-report.

external_research_connections.mechanical_connection: A learner proposes a candidate; a verifier certifies it or returns a counterexample used in the next iteration.
external_research_connections.use_in_TRUMP: Translate OldPvP loser-learning into exact counterexample/debt memory rather than probabilistic reward.

spider_findings: The strongest salvage is competition between verifiable strategies, not competition between theorem claims.
OldPvP's historical-opponent idea should become a regression league of frozen proof receipts.
The loser-learning mechanic has a stricter formal analogue in counterexample-guided synthesis.
Algorithm-portfolio literature supports per-instance strategy selection but does not imply polynomial worst-case complexity.
Proof-carrying-code and LRAT suggest the authority split: aggressive producer/searcher, tiny conservative verifier.
After repeated replay without fresh evidence, TOPA attention weakened across all 12 edges by pass 8; repetition did not inflate evidence.

frozen_R0_experiment.purpose: Test whether a proof-carrying league improves certified progress per charged unit over the same frozen operator/capability universe without changing scientific authority.
frozen_R0_experiment.positive_result_means: The league is a useful candidate search-control mechanism on the frozen evaluated scope.
positive_result_does_not_mean: universal coverage of all SAT families

implementation_priority: P1: Implement an arena adapter around existing TRUMP candidate strategies without changing their theorem face.
P2: Add independent candidate receipt comparator and frozen resource ledger.
P3: Add frozen historical champion bank plus counterexample/debt bank.
P4: Run R0 on preregistered frozen witnesses and preserve OPEN/RESOURCE_LIMIT/INVALID separately.
P5: Only after reproducible gains, test broader witness families; never infer universal complexity from finite tournament wins.
